title: Technician assignment
summary: Assign exactly one technician to each of three machines and minimize total repair time.
task: Which feasible assignment has the minimum total time?

title: 24-hour workforce planning
summary: Schedule eight-hour shifts over six four-hour periods to meet staffing requirements with the fewest workers.
task: What is the minimum number of workers under the corrected coverage model?

title: Investment under variable demand
summary: Choose among three investments without measured probabilities for low, medium, or high demand.
task: Which option is optimal under Laplace’s equally weighted rule?

title: Oil exploration or sell rights
summary: A petroleum company can drill for oil or sell its exploration rights for a fixed payment.
task: Which alternative maximizes expected monetary value?

title: Purchasing spare parts
summary: Decide how many spares to buy upfront when machine failures follow a Poisson model.
task: How many spares minimize expected cost under the conditional 0–6 model?

title: Pricing perfect information
summary: Compare two profit alternatives and calculate the highest break-even price for a perfect forecast.
task: What is the expected value of perfect information?

title: Seasonal production planning
summary: Balance production margins and unsold inventory against three demand forecasts. Payoffs are in thousands.
task: What production plan maximizes expected profit?

title: Staged business expansion
summary: Launch immediately, run an eight-unit pilot and adapt to its result, or keep the current business. Values are in thousands.
task: Which initial branch of the tree has the highest expected profit?

title: Choose an infrastructure project
summary: Budget a procurement project after the contracting regime is confirmed. Costs are in thousands.
task: Which project is least expensive under the confirmed fixed-price regime?

title: Selecting a crop for the season
summary: Choose a crop using worst-case profit when seasonal rain probabilities are unavailable.
task: Which crop wins under the pessimistic Wald criterion?

title: Equipment diagnostic information
summary: Update the probability of a machine fault after a sensor test and compare the value of testing with perfect information.
task: What is the gross value of the sensor reading before paying for the sample?
